name: proto-blocks/oit-breadcrumbs
title: OIT Breadcrumbs
description: Standalone breadcrumb trail (Home > ancestors > current page), auto-derived from the current page's hierarchy. The current crumb is brand red; links inherit the surrounding text color. Drop it near the top of a page; place inside a container to control width.

constrainWidth.label: Constrain to container width
constrainWidth.help: When on, the trail is capped to the 1280px content width with the standard side padding. Off (default) lets it inherit the width of whatever wraps it.
